hook: Your payment on Yap can be a stone disc.
title: The Island Where Money Was Giant Stone
description:
On the Pacific island of Yap, huge stone discs called rai stones were used as money. Some are taller than a person. Ownership could change without the stone ever moving. Part of the series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Geography #Yap
comment_prompt: Would you accept stone money? Yes or no
